protocol.label: PHASE11_ADAPTIVE_PROGRESS_V61
protocol.scope: Oracle geometry evaluation; SE(2) kinematic Isaac Sim; no claim of identical paired RGB
protocol.run_order: index 1..8; sudden D750 then D0, noobs D750 then D0 when eligible; serial; no retry

graph.p_native: (native observation-anchored FRESH endpoint - actual dispatch B.xy) dot B-forward
graph.normalization_note: keep original residual scale/weight; only hinge target changes, fixed per job before solve
graph.unchanged: v6 intent/side, SDF, curvature, boundary curvature, prior, initialization rejection, solver, acceptance, timing, CURV fallback

metrics.safe_passage: first actual72Hz pose after spawn with robot_x-radius > box rear; no dynamic geometric overlap from spawn through that tick (including swept intervals). Conservative contact is not overlap; passage does not imply 2cm margin or goal success.
metrics.topomap_phase: classify backwards transition by newer inference observation pose/time; active iff geometry published by observation_monotonic_ns and unchanged intention(config,pose) is non-null; no world pose used for localization
metrics.graph_population: all submitted jobs; nonconverged uses independent solver success, not rejection disposition; initialization rejection/terminal missing separately; solver-only rate also report
metrics.progress_cost: zero if disabled; missing if no solve; old v6 fixed target .25

decisions.group: scene x delay x method; each involved group independently requires ceil(.875*planned); PLACEMENT_INVALID and technical invalid excluded
decisions.V61_GOAL_IMPROVES: sudden goal successes >= historical v6 successes +3 (reference7/12)
decisions.C6_FIXED: pooled v6.1 short native length <.25 nonconverged/all submissions <= .61/2=.305; missing short calls -> INCONCLUSIVE; all four scene/delay groups required
